meetings.name: Toodyay Hillbilly's Sunday
meetings.notes:
This is an ongoing meeting for men and women. On the first Sunday of each month there will be a BBQ after our meeting.
We believe in the 3 meetings in one thinking. (Ask if not sure).
We practice the 12-Step program as laid out in the Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous.
We offer sponsorship and support to the alcoholic that still suffers.
We believe in our program and our fellowship 100%
We respect any individual as they are, we are about helping with alcoholism nothing more.
We carry the message, not the Alcoholic.
